crossRefs.note: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have…
“Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.
Who has worked and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I, Yahweh, the first, and with the last, I am…
But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me that is to be…
In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
The same was in the beginning with God.
Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”
“I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”
saying, “What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira…
When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, “Don’t be afraid. I am the…
and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.
“To the angel of the assembly in Smyrna write: “The first and the last, who was dead, and has come to life says these…
We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.
even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,
The Word became flesh, and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father, full…
To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days…
for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”
For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ…
See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see…
Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t…
For there are three who testify:
The Word became flesh, and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father, full…
For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.
He is clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood. His name is called “The Word of God.”

translations.web: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life
translations.bsb: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our own eyes, which we have gazed upon and touched with our own hands—this is the Word of life.
translations.kjv: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;
translations.asv: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we beheld, and our hands handled, concerning the Word of life
